meta.description: Post-1956 disasters and major events (Sudan/South Sudan). Figures/tolls only as quoted verbatim. Genocide wording attributed to the finding body. Entries with in_build=false await source registration. Arabic is working translation (AR-REVIEW).

figures.text: nearly 1 million families saw their houses being damaged or completely destroyed

citation.quote: Sudan had not faced such levels of destruction due to rains since 1988, when nearly 1 million families saw their houses being damaged or completely destroyed by the storms.

In 1998, Sudan faced its most serious humanitarian crisis in more than a decade when the combination of a five-year drought and intensified conflict produced a major famine in the Bahr Al Ghazal region that put nearly 800,000 persons at risk of starvation. ... By early June, ... the number of people in need of food assistance was found to have risen to 795,000 persons.

title.ar: دارفور 2003–: قرارات ونتائج بشأن الإبادة الجماعية (منسوبة) [يحتاج تحقق]

summary.en: The US Secretary of State concluded in September 2004 that genocide had been committed in Darfur. The UN International Commission of Inquiry (S/2005/60) concluded the Government of the Sudan had NOT pursued a policy of genocide. The ICC charges Omar al-Bashir with, among other things, three counts of genocide allegedly committed between 2003 and 2008 (warrants 4 Mar 2009 and 12 Jul 2010).
summary.ar: خلص وزير الخارجية الأمريكي في سبتمبر 2004 إلى وقوع إبادة جماعية في دارفور، بينما خلصت لجنة التحقيق الدولية التابعة للأمم المتحدة إلى أن حكومة السودان لم تنتهج سياسة إبادة جماعية، وتوجه المحكمة الجنائية الدولية إلى عمر البشير ثلاث تهم بالإبادة الجماعية. [يحتاج تحقق]

citation.quote: I concluded, that genocide has been committed in Darfur and that the Government of Sudan and the Jingaweit bear responsibility -- and that genocide may still be occurring.

citation_2.quote: 518. Conclusion. On the basis of the foregoing observations, the Commission concludes that the Government of the Sudan has not pursued a policy of genocide.

citation_3.quote: three counts of genocide: by killing, by causing serious bodily or mental harm, and by deliberately inflicting on each target group conditions of life calculated to bring about the group's physical destruction, allegedly committed at least between 2003 and 2008 in Darfur, Sudan The first warrant for arrest for Omar Hassan Ahmad Al Bashir was issued on 4 March 2009, the second on 12 July 2010.

title.ar: عمليات القتل في الجنينة 2023 (استهداف المساليت) [يحتاج تحقق]

summary.en: According to the UN Panel of Experts (S/2024/65), RSF and allied militias targeted the Masalit community in West Darfur; violations may amount to war crimes and crimes against humanity. The Panel did not use the word genocide in this passage.
summary.ar: وفقا لفريق خبراء الأمم المتحدة استهدفت قوات الدعم السريع والميليشيات المتحالفة معها مجتمع المساليت في غرب دارفور. [يحتاج تحقق]

toll.text: In El Geneina alone, between 10,000 and 15,000 people were killed.

citation.quote: In West Darfur (El Geneina, Sirba, Murne and Masteri), RSF and allied militias targeted the Masalit community in particular. RSF allied militias systematically violated international humanitarian law. Some of those violations may amount to war crimes and crimes against humanity. ... In El Geneina alone, between 10,000 and 15,000 people were killed.

title.ar: قرار الولايات المتحدة بشأن الإبادة الجماعية ضد الدعم السريع (يناير 2025) [يحتاج تحقق]

summary.en: On 7 January 2025 the US Secretary of State concluded that members of the RSF and allied militias have committed genocide in Sudan (US government determination).
summary.ar: في 7 يناير 2025 خلص وزير الخارجية الأمريكي إلى أن أفرادا من قوات الدعم السريع والميليشيات المتحالفة ارتكبوا إبادة جماعية في السودان. [يحتاج تحقق]

citation.quote: Based on this information, I have now concluded that members of the RSF and allied militias have committed genocide in Sudan.

title.en: RSF takeover of El Fasher (Oct 2025) – FFM 'hallmarks of genocide'
title.ar: سيطرة الدعم السريع على الفاشر (أكتوبر 2025) [يحتاج تحقق]

summary.en: The UN Independent International Fact-Finding Mission for the Sudan (A/HRC/61/77, Feb 2026) assessed that RSF mass killings during the takeover of El Fasher on or around 26–27 October 2025, after an 18-month siege, are 'indicators of a genocidal path' (Mission's assessment, not a court ruling).
summary.ar: قدرت بعثة الأمم المتحدة المستقلة لتقصي الحقائق أن عمليات القتل الجماعي أثناء سيطرة الدعم السريع على الفاشر في 26–27 أكتوبر 2025 مؤشرات على مسار إبادة جماعية. [يحتاج تحقق]

citation.quote: The Independent International Fact-Finding Mission for the Sudan (“the Mission”) assesses that the mass killings and related atrocities committed by the Rapid Support Forces in and around El-Fasher, during its takeover of the city on or around 26 and 27 October 2025, are indicators of a genocidal path.
